C0412.title: Technical Breakdown: HackerOne Two-Factor Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
C0412.summary: In 2018, a HackerOne report disclosed a bypass of the platform's 2FA requirement in its vulnerability report submission flow. The researcher found that the main submission page required users to enable two-factor authentication, but the embedded submission form did not enforce the same check, allowing users without 2FA enabled to continue submitting reports; the bypass also affected reporter blacklist checks.
